summary: The global marketing team is executing a China-first strategy, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs while managing multiple high-stakes deliverables and resolving an urgent Outlook account lockout.
summaryDetail: The most critical issue right now is the Outlook account lockout affecting the team's ability to communicate and access resources; all devices must be cleaned and re-logged with the new password, and JSB must confirm the backend unlock. In parallel, the team is advancing the China-first marketing strategy, with Asia Star and Intelligent China as top priorities, including SEO, conversion tracking, and content updates; Joseph must share the updated Intelligent China webpage with Jay and Global Programs colleagues. This week also sees key deadlines: Joseph needs to provide October priorities for the Global Marcom work report, Julie must submit the SIP draft for PRME by Sep 30, and LIU Xuan must provide information for the Sino-Swiss Economic Forum. On the events front, follow-up for Tech in Asia Conference participants is underway, with thank-you emails and touch points being created, while the CKGSB-IE report promotion and Asia Start video logo update are also in motion. Upcoming, the knowledge website redesign is progressing with Joseph's design inspiration and BCI integration, and the team must continue prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China while researching participants and CRM leads.
